question: On 5th February 2022, who became the first Indian cricketer to take 5 wickets in the U19 World Cup final held against England in North Sound, Antigua?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raj Angad Bawa.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **​****Raj Angad Bawa** became the** first Indian cricketer** to bag a fifer in an ICC tournament final when he finished with figures of 5/31 in the U19 World Cup final against England in North Sound, Antigua on Saturday.
 
• **Raj Angad Bawa **combined with **Ravi Kumar**, who bagged 4/34, to bowl England out for 189 in the summit clash. 
 
• **Raj Angad Bawa** also became the first player since Pakistan's** Anwar Ali** in 2006 to pick a five-wicket haul in an ICC U19 World Cup final. 
 
• In finals, **Raj Angad Bawa** and **Ravi's** heroics helped India win the title.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The World cup was held against **England** in **North Sound, Antigua**.
 
• **India** lifted the U19 World cup for the **fifth** time.
 
• The **2023 ICC Men's Cricket World Cup** will be the **13th edition** of the men's Cricket World Cup, scheduled to be hosted by **India** during October and November 2023.
 
• This will be the **first** time the competition is held entirely in **India**.
